author: Karl Rock
description:
Ever seen a motorcycle built just for goats? 🐐😂

This isn't a random sight. These specially modified motorcycles are used to transport goats safely through the streets of Pakistan.

The goats are being delivered for Sadaqah (voluntary charity), where they're donated, sacrificed according to Islamic tradition, and the meat is distributed to families in need. During occasions like Eid al-Adha, or as an act of charity throughout the year, it's common to see animals being transported in creative ways like this.

It might look funny, but it's actually a practical solution for navigating busy streets while carrying valuable livestock. Pakistan never fails to surprise me!
title: Pakistan's Goat Taxi 🐐
